description: This file defines the `WriteResultAndErrors` class, a data structure used to encapsulate results and errors from MongoDB bulk write operations within the context of a reliable search index update. It includes methods for creating instances based on success, failure, or unexpected errors, and provides accessors for its fields.

classes.name: WriteResultAndErrors
classes.description: Immutable data class encapsulating write models, bulk write results, errors, and possible unexpected error for MongoDB write operations in search index update processes.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates a successful `WriteResultAndErrors` instance with provided write models and bulk write result, indicating no errors.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Creates a `WriteResultAndErrors` instance representing a failure scenario from a `MongoBulkWriteException`, capturing write models, bulk write result, and errors.

methods.name: unexpectedError
methods.description: Creates a `WriteResultAndErrors` instance representing an unexpected error occurred during write operations, capturing the write models and the Throwable error.

methods.name: getWriteModels
methods.description: Returns the list of write models that were requested.

methods.name: getBulkWriteResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the bulk write operation.

methods.name: getBulkWriteErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors encountered during the bulk write.

methods.name: getUnexpectedError
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the unexpected Throwable error, if any.
